title: Cardinal Billing Account Payment Posting, Phone Payment Fee and Tolerance Schedule
content:
These Cardinal Billing Account figures govern how a payment is posted and what a payment taken by a representative costs, by pay plan.

| Pay plan | Phone representative payment fee | Posting cutoff (Eastern time) | Underpayment tolerance | Overpayment held for the next installment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Direct Bill Monthly Plan | $5.00 | 20:00 | $2.00 | Yes |
| Cardinal Card Autopay Monthly Plan | $0.00 | 20:00 | $2.00 | Yes |
| Cardinal EFT Autopay Monthly Plan | $0.00 | 20:00 | $0.00 | Yes |
| Cardinal Three-Pay Plan | $5.00 | 20:00 | $2.00 | Yes |
| Cardinal Two-Pay Plan | $5.00 | 20:00 | $2.00 | Yes |
| Cardinal Paid-in-Full Plan | $5.00 | 20:00 | $2.00 | No |

## Column notes

- **Phone representative payment fee**: the pay plan's fee figure for a one-time payment taken by a customer service representative by phone. Self-service channels are free.
- **Posting cutoff**: a same-day payment made after 20:00 Eastern time posts the next calendar day.
- **Underpayment tolerance**: the shortfall up to which an installment is treated as paid for late-fee and notice purposes; the shortfall stays on the balance. On the Cardinal EFT Autopay Monthly Plan the tolerance is $0.00, so any shortfall counts.
- **Overpayment held for the next installment**: "Yes" means an overpayment is held as a credit against the next installment rather than refunded; on the Cardinal Paid-in-Full Plan it is "No".

Hypothetical reading: on the Cardinal Two-Pay Plan an installment paid $1.50 short is treated as paid for late-fee and notice purposes, because $1.50 is within the $2.00 tolerance, and the $1.50 stays on the balance.
